'''Death Star (Japanese)''' is the Japanese-language printing of [[Death Star]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

== Title ==
<span lang="ja">デス・スター</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Card Text ==
'''Dark Side'''
<span lang="ja">X＝現在位置のパーセク数。パーセク0に配備する。航行速度＝1。「革命」の影響を受けない。ゲーム開始時に出したならライトサイドが先攻。</span><ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

'''Light Side'''
No game text is printed.<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Lore ==
No lore is printed.<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" />

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
AI English reading aid (Memory Core ChatGPT, 7 November 2026).

'''Title'''
<blockquote>Death Star</blockquote>

'''Lore'''
No lore is printed.

'''Game text'''
<blockquote>X = the parsec number of the current position. Deploy at parsec 0. Hyperspeed = 1. Unaffected by Revolution. If put out at the start of the game, the Light Side goes first.</blockquote>

The Japanese says “deploy at parsec 0”; the original English says “Must deploy at Parsec 0.” Its final sentence says that if the card is put out at the start of the game, the Light Side goes first, while the English says “If this is your starting location, Light Side goes first in game.” Both faces show X for the current parsec, hyperspeed 1, three Dark Side Force icons and the mobile symbol. Neither has lore or Light Side game text.<ref name="encyclopedia-172-full-source" /><ref name="english-face">[[:File:ANH-D-deathstar.gif|Original English card face]].</ref>

== Rules ==
The November 1998 [[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] states that English is the standard for tournament play, directing foreign-language cards and rules to be played and interpreted as their English counterparts under current rulings, errata and clarifications.<ref name="foreign-language-rule">[[Media:Decipher Glossary 1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998), p. 62, Foreign-language cards and rules.</ref>
